{{contact.first_name}}, quick follow-up on your macros.
If you only track one number, make it protein. It protects your strength while everything else moves. Your target is {{contact.macro_protein}}g a day. Across four meals that is about {{contact.macro_protein_per_meal}}g each.
What a solid serving looks like
■4 oz cooked chicken breast: about 35g
■1 cup plain Greek yogurt: about 23g
■4 large eggs: about 24g
■A 5 oz can of tuna: about 25g
■1 scoop of whey: usually 20 to 25g, check the label
Two habits that make it easy
■Get 30g or more at breakfast. Most people come up short because the first meal is all carbs.
■Keep a backup on hand. A shake, jerky or a protein bar covers the days that go sideways.
